enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Keen: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.

Improved Destruction: On Hit: Your target gains a stack of Armor Destruction. (-1 penalty to Armor Class, -1% of its Fortification. 20 Second Duration. Stacks up to 15 times.) This effect may trigger once every second.
Shocking Blast 6: This weapon arcs with deadly electricity, dealing 6d6 Electric damage on a successful hit, and an additional 6d6 Electric damage on a critical hit.
Shatter +15: This effect gives a +15 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Sunder and Improved Sunder attempts.

Utter Disintegration: This weapon has a dark, insidious power deep within. Occasionally, this power lashes out violently at enemies and attempts to disintegrate them. This disintegrate is incredibly powerful, and will utterly destroy weaker foes.
Legendary Chimera's Ferocity: This item grants extra bonuses if the wearer has been bestowed with Dragonmarks. Any dragonmark grants Proficiency: Bastard Sword; further bonuses are detailed below.

children.text: If you have a Dragonmark, you get Exotic Weapon Proficiency: Bastard Sword and one of the following:

children.tooltip: Insightful Fortification +73%: +73% Insight bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.

children.text: Mark of Healing: Competence Healing Amplification +54
children.tooltip: Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +54 (Competence bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Repair Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming repair healing by +54 (Enhancement bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Resistance +11: Passive: +11 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.

Shield +13: While this item is equipped, you are partially protected by a field of magical force which can deflect enemy attacks. This item provides a +13 Shield bonus to Armor Class. It does not stack with an equipped shield.
Incite +124: +124% Enhancement bonus to increased threat generation from melee damage
Lesser Displacement: Equipping this item causes light to distort around you. Attacks from enemies have a 25% chance to miss you due to concealment.

children.text: Mark of Storm: Electric Absorption +35% and Whirlwind Ward
children.tooltip: Electric Absorption +35%: Passive: 35% Enhancement Bonus to Electric Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)Whirlwind Ward: This effect renders you immune to being knocked down by an Air Elemental's whirlwind. However, it does not prevent you from being knocked back or away from touching the Air Elemental.
Spell Resistance +39: +39 Enhancement bonus to Spell Resistance.

enchantments.tooltip: Silver: A complex process involving metallurgy and alchemy can bond silver to a weapon made of steel so that it bypasses the damage reduction of creatures such as devils and vampires. Silver weapons have 2 points lower hardness then equivalent steel weapons, and as such aren't quite as durable.
